ask: this is a mess pls sort it out
sentence: A shared timeline of dates for a group where each person taps the dates they are in for, owners can remove their own dates, and a short list shows who brings which side dish.
use_when: a group wants one shared list of upcoming dates and who is going to each
people need to sign up to help at events or show up for a friend's event
a group dinner needs each person to claim a side dish
a messy mix of schedules and plans needs to be put in one place
dont_use_when: the group needs to vote on one date or option, which needs a poll
someone wants a personal reminder or alarm for a single event
the group needs to split costs or track who owes money
